narrative:
Inventory optimization for material PL1__M3CACBCE reveals a moderate demand pattern with mean daily demand of 426.8 units and unstable lead times (mean 1.4 days, CV 0.68). 

The analysis recommends a safety stock of 727 units (vs. current 0) and order quantity of 3172 units (vs. current 112) to achieve 95% service level. 

This optimization yields annual cost savings of $43,557.11 (91.3%), reducing total inventory costs from $47,692.34 to $4,135.24. The recommended policy maintains 22.6% storage utilization, well within capacity constraints.

Key insights: The current policy of minimal safety stock (0) with frequent small orders (MOQ=112) is highly inefficient, generating excessive ordering costs ($47,632.94/year). The optimized policy balances ordering frequency with holding costs through larger, less frequent replenishments.
